chunks: With this chain of narrators, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Fadala, from al-Aban, from Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Saqil, that he said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: It was found on the top of the sword of Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him and his Family) a journal, and in it was written: 'In the Name of Allah, the Merciful to all, the Merciful in particular. Indeed, the most unruly of people in the sight of Allah on the Day of Resurrection is the one who kills other than his killer, who hits other than his hitter, and who befriends other than his allies. He is disbelieving in what Allah, Exalted is He, has sent down unto Muhammad (peace be upon him and his Family). Furthermore, the one who commits a sin or gives refuge to a sinner, Allah, Exalted is He, will not accept from him ransom, nor dispursal.'

He said: Then he said: Do you know the meaning of his saying: 'who befriends other than his allies'? I said: What does he mean with it? He said: He means the people of religion. The ransom is repentance, according to the saying of Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), and the dispursal is redemption, according to the saying of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him).

key_terms.الْعَدْلُ: justice or redemption/expiation in this context
key_terms.ذُؤَابَةِ: top or tip of the sword

ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of the most unruly people on the Day of Judgment according to the inscription on the Prophet's sword?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar* highlights the esoteric significance of the Prophet’s sword, linking physical combat ethics to spiritual allegiance (*walayah*) with the Ahl al-Bayt. It clarifies that 'those who befriend non-allies' refers to those who neglect the rightful religious authorities, while defining 'ransom' and 'redemption' as repentance and expiation respectively, emphasizing that sincere internal transformation is required for divine acceptance.

en.basel-kadem: 3.	With this chain of narrators, from Hussain bin Sa’eed, from Fadala, from Aban, from Ishaq bin Ibrahim al-Sayqal, that he said:

Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, said: It was found on the top of the sword of Allah’s Messenger, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, a journal, and in it was written: «In the Name of Allah, the Merciful to all, the Merciful in particular. Indeed, the most unruly of people in the sight of Allah on the Day of Resurrection is the one kills other than his killer, who hits other than his hitter and who befriends other than his allies. He is disbelieving in what Allah, Exalted is He, has sent down unto Muhammed, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family. Furthermore, the one who performs a sin or gives refuge to a sinner, Allah, Exalted is He, will not accept from him ransom, nor dispursal.

He said: He then said: Do you know the meaning of his saying: «who befriends other than his allies»? I said: What does he mean with it? He said: He means the people of religion. The ransom is repentance, according to the saying of Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him, and the dispursal is redemption, according to the saying of Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him.
